description_zh: 生成与标注校验约定；日韩 origin 与所有语言 POS 均逐词义必填。
validation_rules: tag must exist and be assignable, or refer to a validated auto_added proposal
sense_ids must be nonempty and refer to senses in this note
source_ref must resolve to fetched source metadata or a stored model-run identifier
confidence is a qualitative review aid, not a calibrated probability
low-confidence classification is unresolved metadata, not automatically applied
ancestral duplicates are removed before emitting note_tags
origin tags are disallowed for en
parent and child languages must agree; wildcard means language-independent
pos is limited to noun, verb, adjective, adverb, affix and other; preserve fine POS in source metadata
AI-proposed domain tags have at most three segments; existing user-defined Anki sublabels may be deeper
regional uses fixed restricted-use labels only; standard and general usage are untagged
medium is not a supported dimension
every sense requires POS; every ja/ko sense requires one or more origin tags
mixed origin components may emit multiple origin tags with component-specific reasons
domain describes core topic or referent, not only specialist terminology
existing Anki tags are merged with the seed vocabulary into a per-batch snapshot used by generation and review
import revalidates user-defined tags against the current Anki tag list
